triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: All sorts of extraordinary tales were told about her, amazing anecdotes of her passion for Mitya, in spite of his crime.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: The public was looking forward with anxious curiosity to the meeting of the two rivals—the proud aristocratic girl and “the hetaira.”

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: The court usher was told to bring in the prisoner, and Mitya made his appearance.

triples.subject: Fetyukovitch
triples.quote: Everybody was excited at the presence of the celebrated lawyer, Fetyukovitch.

triples.subject: Ippolit Kirillovitch
triples.quote: It was said that Ippolit Kirillovitch was in a tremor at meeting Fetyukovitch, and that they had been enemies from the beginning of their careers in Petersburg
